cases.initializationReady: reports readiness only when the SDK status succeeds
cases.initializationUnavailable: does not report readiness when SDK status is unavailable
cases.initializationRejected: does not report readiness when SDK status rejects
cases.openExit: returns true for a direction with an open exit
cases.blockedExit: returns false for a direction whose exit is null
cases.missingExit: returns false for a direction absent from the exits
cases.oracleDialogue: uses Oracle dialogue as the successful description
cases.qualifiedPrompt: sends the authored verdict context to the Oracle
cases.unexpectedPrompt: includes the event and scene in Oracle context
cases.rollRange: reports the authored primary roll and surge update
cases.qualifiedSurge: applies the authored qualified surge update
cases.unexpectedEvent: surfaces an unexpected event and roll
cases.unavailable: preserves the mechanical result when Oracle narration is unavailable
cases.stress: applies current system stress to the roll
cases.sanitization: removes reserved delimiters from player text
